answer: Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 3 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in quill and signal lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the velvet graph. Verification costs 2 dollars and 3 days per identity, which turns a 963 account sybil into a 7 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
